notes: delay = run created_at - nominal tick; the tick is the latest one at or before created_at under the cron lines in the workflow file at the run's head_sha. A delay longer than the interval would be attributed to a later tick, so delays are only reported as trustworthy for crons at least --unambiguous-min apart, and for workflows where (nearly) every tick has exactly one run.
coverage = ticks with a run / ticks between the first and last observed run. Missed ticks are counted inside that span only.
Only the latest 100 schedule runs per repository are fetched (one page, shared by all its scheduled workflows), so a workflow's span is whatever those runs cover.

other_event_runs_between: run numbers count every run of a workflow, so jumps between consecutive schedule runs are runs from other triggers (workflow_dispatch, push, ...), e.g. an external pinger that dispatches the workflow.
queue = run_started_at - created_at for first attempts.
status: stopped = no schedule run for max(24 h, 2 intervals + 12 h) before now; complete = coverage >= 0.95; skips = otherwise.

Sample: public forks of the template pushed in the last 60 days (GitHub disables schedules after 60 days without activity), newest push first, as far as the unauthenticated budget reached. Private repositories and accounts on paid plans are not represented.
